title: Very good quality
text: Very good quality. I love this blanket. I can't express enough how good quality this is. I have a thing about blankets. I have a lot of blankets with all kinds of quality. This one is near the top. So soft and almost feels like real fur. You won't regret this purchase. I'm thinking about getting more to put up for gifts.

product_metadata.title: Gemarwel Faux Fur Soft Blanket - Throw Blanket for Couch, Luxurious Warm Throw Cozy Fuzzy Blanket(50x60,Ruched Leopard)
features: ANIMAL-FRIENDLY: Made of 100% microfiber polyester. Artfully mimics real fur for maximum softness and breathability. The durable construction means our fuzzy soft blanket resists color fading, stains, and everyday wear & tear.
ULTRA SOFT & COZY: Gemarwel fluffy soft throw blanket is made of premium milky powder plush, which looks like cotton but feels like silk. Super soft, cozy, and comfortable.

ELEGANT HOME DECOR-Stylish design makes this ruched leopard fur throw blanket perfect for draping over a chair, sofa, or bed, chilly movie theater, park, or perfect personal gift for any occasion. Add extra texture to your home decor.

EASY CARE: Ours was created with ease of care in mind. Using cold water and your machine's gentle cycle, you can keep your throw blanket fresh and clean for years. And to make drying simple, it's dryer safe when using the tumble dry gentle cycle and NO HEAT. IMPORTANT: Wash before use to avoid shedding.
